name: Grand Dine Restaurant Deira مطعم جراند داين ديرة
address: Al Muteena - Deira - Dubai - United Arab Emirates
owner_description: Grand Dine Restaurant Deira – مطعم جراند داين ديرة offers authentic Turkish, Afghani, Indian, Steak, Arabic, and Middle Eastern cuisines in a luxury, family-friendly setting in Al Muteena, Deira Dubai. Popular with tourists, residents, families, and friends, we serve premium grills, live charcoal dishes, seafood specials, mandi, and beautifully presented meals. Located near major hotels and attractions, Grand Dine delivers a warm dining experience with rich flavours generous portions, and a welcoming ambience for everyone.

reviews.author: Local Guide & Explorer
reviews.text:
Amazing Ambience, Great Service, and Very Affordable! 👌
I recently visited Grand Dine Restaurant located on Al Mateena Street in Deira, Dubai. It is a remarkably spacious and beautiful restaurant with a fantastic, clean, and peaceful ambience. In addition to their comfortable indoor seating, they also have a great outdoor seating area.
They offer a wonderful variety of cuisines, including Afghani, Pakistani, Indian, and Iraqi dishes. We ordered the Iraqi specialty, Masgoof Fish with Rice. The fish was huge, weighing well over a kilo, and the portion was more than enough to comfortably satisfy 3 to 4 people. Given the excellent quality and quantity, the pricing is highly affordable and pocket-friendly.
Another highlight was the delicious complimentary Mutton Soup they served us upon request. The staff was incredibly welcoming and more than happy to provide it.
Parking is also very convenient here. While there is paid road-side parking available, the restaurant also provides its own Free Parking right at the back of the shop, which is a huge plus for anyone driving here.
The service deserves a special mention. Both the Nepali waitress and the Indian waiter took excellent care of us. The Nepali waitress, in particular, managed most of our service and handled our orders with an incredibly polite, warm, and professional attitude.
If you are looking for a place with an amazing atmosphere, a wide variety of cuisines, exceptional customer service, and great value for money, Grand Dine is highly recommended!

reviews.author: anish thomas
reviews.text:
This is the second time I am visiting Grand Dine in less than a month.

First time, it was a wonderful experience. Vehicle parking was taken care of by Mr. Basil who assisted us till the restaurant and was so friendly. Our table was served by Ms. Vasana, who was also wonderful.

On my second visit today, we were served by another waiter. His service was utterly terrible. We ordered almost 6 dishes out of which only 3 came and 1 was wrong. On top of that, we asked for 2 glasses of warm water for my kids who weren't well and he refused to serve it saying that it isn't allowed.

We mainly came here to try their Beef Kushwa which was recommended to us, but it never came to the table.

We were forced to complain at the main counter,  and after that service went smooth. Mr. Basil and Ms. Vasana made the experience much better after that.

The food here tastes really good, and there are few staff here who's work is well commendable. But few others who ruin the experience, hope the management does the needful to train them properly and not lose customers due to this.
